versions.changelog:
Initial release of mailscope-email-detection-skill.

- Enables security analysis of email (.eml) files, including phishing and malware detection.
- Supports API key configuration through user instructions in either Chinese or English.
- Guides the user to ensure Node.js 22+ is installed and API key is set before analysis.
- Provides instructions for running the analysis script and interpreting the results.
- Includes comprehensive error handling and clear user guidance for common setup and analysis issues.
